description: Plan v7 section 8.3 fixture family 'loader-path-shapes'. Inputs only; the oracle emits expected.

cases.notes: DISCRIMINATING: a port that let the host filesystem error escape reports an ENOENT rather than the library's own message, and a port that collapsed the two Location guards reports the not-a-directory wording instead.
DISCRIMINATING against its sibling: the path EXISTS here, so only a port that tests existence and directory-ness separately produces this message rather than the absent-path one.
DISCRIMINATING: a port that recursed loads fr as well as en. Until S14 ablating the child-directory skip turned 0 required cases red -- this is the case that changes that.

DISCRIMINATING against the sibling above: the same directory loads at budget 2 and refuses at 1, so the skipped child is proven to have been COUNTED. A port that charged the budget only for files it parsed passes the sibling and fails here.

DISCRIMINATING: a port that opened the entry before stat'ing it BLOCKS FOREVER on a FIFO with no writer rather than refusing, and one that skipped non-regular files silently loads en alone. The message quotes the CANONICAL path, which is the form :1757 uses.
